rule: Each Au+Au embedded sample keeps only the events it owns: an inclusive-jet sample the events whose leading anti-kT R = 0.4 truth jet pT lies in its window, a photon+jet sample the events whose generator-filter photon pT lies in its window. Windows are half open [low, high); a null high is unbounded. Every owned event carries cross_section_pb / N, with N the sample's events in its own window (inclusive jets) or all of its post-filter events (photon+jet).
